recorded_fix.rule: Admit iff used_total + projected_next <= max_input_tokens, where projected_next = tokens_last + max(0, bytes_next - common_prefix_bytes) + 64 for any received prior attempt, and projected_next = bytes_next (the original byte reservation) when the scope has no received attempt yet.
recorded_fix.soundness: Server tokenization is deterministic per byte string: bytes identical to the latest request's archived body contribute the same tokens they contributed there (bounded by tokens_last). Every new or rewritten byte contributes at most one token per byte for any tokenizer whose tokens cover non-empty byte spans (tokens <= bytes). The 64-token margin covers server chat-template growth for the at most three new messages, the final assistant priming, and tokenizer merges across the prefix boundary.
recorded_fix.evidence_rule: tokens_last and used_total come from the archived receipts' normalized raw_usage (actual server-reported values), never from byte ratios. The latest attempt's archived request.body is digest-verified before use; an unreadable archive fails budget_unknown instead of projecting.
